title: Soft-focus fields / Blue day
description: An optically blurred meadow with blue sky and lime grasses.
prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: text-free Recoup brand background study, wide 16:9 landscape. Deliberate photographic defocus and very fine film grain, art-directed like an independent music magazine cover photograph. Real optical blur, natural light, tactile atmosphere. Recoup colors: sky blue #007EBD, forest green #132B26, lime #D6FF62, ice blue and chalk white. Keep broad low-detail areas so a separate headline or white graphic card can be overlaid. No people, text, logo, typography, frame, border, interface, or watermark. No collage or contact sheet. Render ONE complete high-resolution background.
Scene: low, distant rolling green meadow under saturated blue sky, foreground grasses become large soft lime shapes at the edges. Everything intentionally out of focus as if the lens is focused far beyond the scene. Broad horizontal bands of color, horizon at lower third, bright afternoon. Soft sun haze. The impression of a field is recognizable, but no individual blades or flowers resolve sharply.
note: First study generated from the shared palette before the reference-based variations.

title: Grainy airbrush / Blue and lime
description: Oversized airbrushed color fields with a tactile print grain.
prompt:

Art direction for contemporary music culture, confident and tactile, not corporate presentation wallpaper. Palette limited to sky blue #007EBD, deep forest #132B26, bright lime #D6FF62, icy pale blue and chalk white. A deliberate composition with room for a separate clear headline or graphic card. No text, letters, logo, interface, border, watermark or literal music clipart. ONE complete high-resolution background, not a collage or contact sheet.
Style: analog airbrush poster artwork photographed close, enormous diffuse lime crescent entering from lower-right across saturated sky-blue pigment, chalk-white mist near upper-left; deep forest appears only as a soft sliver. Visible superfine pigment stippling, saturated editorial color, sculptural imperfect gradients made by sprayed ink rather than a clean software mesh. Calm blue center occupies half the image. Flat 2D graphic art with soft atmospheric boundaries, no objects.
note: First study generated from the shared palette before the reference-based variations.
